payload.prompt:
Wrenwell, Dublin. Business debit card and invoicing app for sole traders. Run the campaign from Saturday, January 16, 2027 to Wednesday, January 27, 2027, Dublin time. Goal is as many app installs as possible; installs are what we count. Landing page is https://wrenwell.ie/card. No X pixel on the site, so X won't see the installs. Our posts and landing page do the work: people tap through to the page and install from the App Store or Google Play there, so there's no app-install campaign or app ID to set up. We're a financial service and hold the licences we need in both countries, and X has approved our account for financial services ads in the United Kingdom and Ireland. Here's the copy from our landing page: "Wrenwell is a business debit card and account for sole traders, with invoices you send straight from the app and incoming payments matched to them automatically. Your first three months are free, then it's €7 a month in Ireland or £6 a month in the United Kingdom. Open to sole traders in Ireland and the United Kingdom, through the Wrenwell app for iPhone and Android only." You can launch and manage it yourself, no need to check with us. Keep an eye on it for the whole run. When it ends, send a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks.

Total budget: 350.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
